evidence.evidence_text: In this study, we develop Almanac, a large language model framework augmented with retrieval capabilities for medical guideline and treatment recommendations.

Performance on a novel dataset of clinical scenarios (n = 130) evaluated by a panel of 5 board-certified and resident physicians demonstrates significant increases in factuality (mean of 18% at p-value < 0.05) across all specialties, with improvements in completeness and safety.
In this study, we develop Almanac, a large language model framework augmented with retrieval capabilities for medical guideline and treatment recommendations.
